# surface: help__all
# argv: sila help all
# mode: help
# exit: 0
--- stdout ---
sila - one shared memory, rulebook, and plan for every AI coding agent.
  Part of the devtools family by Jad Madi (@jadmadi on X.com)

Usage:
  sila <command> [args...] [flags]

Agent Continuity & Working Loop:
  salam (alias: hi, hello, merhaba) [--assist] [--json]                   Agent front door: 7-step working loop, ready goals & active claims
  workspace                         status [--json]                       Resolve the active project identity from a workspace root, child repo, or subdirectory
  prime                             [--top=N] [--budget=<tokens>]         Session-start context briefing with declarative token compression
  preflight                         status|set off|warn|enforce [--user]  Inspect or set the Command Code preflight policy and marker validation
  handoff                           [<summary>] [--open=...]              View or record structured session handoffs & open items
  standup (deprecated alias: recap) [last <window>] [-g]                  Human morning standup: decisions, commits shipped, open items
  hook                              [session-start|session-end]           Execute agent lifecycle hooks & git pre-commit quality gates
  session                           start|status|env|end|list|prune       Resolve, export, bind, and track local agent session identity
  memory                            add|validate|show|list|digest|archive|restore|history|report|prune
                                    Typed sila/memory/v1 envelopes, reversible archive/restore lifecycle, validation, digests, and adoption reports
  intro                             [--agent=<name>]                      Agent onboarding guide & AGENTS.md template block

Knowledge, Recall & Memory:
  search              <query> [--omni] | expand <id>     Search knowledge: omni-search, messages, claims, or docs
  recall              "<symptom|error>" [--top=N]        Fast cross-project solution lookup before web search
  doc                 <url|file|search|pkg|sites>        Ingest, crawl, search, serve, or query external docs & packages
  memo                add|list|show [--text=] [--since=] [--limit=N] [--claim=] [--json]
                      Record, list, or show architectural directives; 'memo list' never writes
  lesson              add|list|show|distill [--since=] [--json]
                      Record, browse, show, or distill bug-cause-fix solution lessons
  case (alias: cases) add|list|show [--since=] [--json]  Record, browse, or show architectural procedural cases
  facts               [verify|show <id>|list]            Cryptographic SHA-256 hash-chained fact ledger audit
  guide               [domain] [--format=...] [--out=]   Compile and export living Developer Operational Guidebook (10 domains)
  learn               [list|add|export] [domain]         Record, list, and export distilled operational learnings & guardrails
  graph               build | report | query | slice | path | affected | stats | doctor
                      Build, audit, query, slice, blast-radius, and inspect the code + memory graph

Roadmap, Governance & Multi-Agent:
  goals                     [claim|release|ready|review]           Roadmap matrix, claims, commit matching & Plannotator review
  vision                    [compile|triage|add-nongoal]           Strategic North Star, VISION.md compiler & proposal triage
  approve (alias: approval) [<id>] [--reject] [--pending]          Human-in-the-loop approval steering for autonomous AI agents
  adr                       [new|list|compile|doctor]              Author, compile, ground, and doctor Architecture Decision Records
  decision                  [create|resolve|list|view|check]       Epistemic addressed decision log (D#), options & collision check
  opinions                  [compile|add|list] [--toon]            Living technical taste ledger & OPINIONS.md compilation
  feedback                  [<msg>] [--type=...] [--issue]         Closed-loop feedback ticket ledger for agent suggestions & issues
  crew                      [spawn|list|status|kill]               First Mate crew orchestrator: tmux sessions with zero-token supervision
  worktree                  [create|list|clean|run]                Disposable Git worktree sandboxes with context seeding & gates
  man                       [topic] [--search=<term>] [--json]     Read the embedded manual pages
  daemon                    start|stop|status [--foreground] [--socket=<path>]
                            Run the local Unix-socket daemon with one store and a proxied MCP path
  commits                   [--since=<dur>] [--json] | show <sha>  Commit-to-session receipts from the local store
  digest                    [--activity] [--since=24h]             Multi-agent activity digest & session ledger for AI coding agents
  benchmark                 [--min-sessions=N] [--toon]            Cross-agent empirical scorecard: grounding rate & goal attribution
  pause                     [--global] [--reason=<text>]           Pause hook and MCP capture; reads stay available
  resume                    [--global]                             Resume capture and clear a forget exclusion
  forget                    [--include-transcripts] [--yes]        Archive captured knowledge and exclude it from reads

Personas, Audits & Skill Authoring:
  persona                                            list [--group=ID] | get <id|num>  Modular persona registry & edge vault across 31 specialist personas
  hire                                               group <id> | <1,4,6,3,8> [url]    Autonomous multi-persona hiring, group audits, and goal package synthesis
  reports                                            [list] | show <id>                Browse, inspect, and trace persona evaluation reports in .sila/reports/
  audit                                              web <url> | squad | gap           Autonomous multi-agent groupthink audit & Sila goals synthesis
  skill (alias: skills, skill-create, skills-create) preview | apply | remove | assess | list | show | create
                                                     Project skill governance, filtering, assessment & bespoke skill authoring
  plugins (alias: plugin)                            list | init | install | uninstall | link | unlink | lint
                                                     Manage standalone Go plugins and tools

Quality Gates, Verification & Health:
  gate                            [pipeline|install|coverage]       Local quality gate pipeline: pre-commit/pre-push & sentries
  doctor                          [--repair] [--edge] [--skills]    End-to-end SQLite integrity, index sync, skill bloat & test audit
  verify                          [<project>] [--dry-run] [--json]  Re-verify referenced files on disk and detect stale claims
  soak                            [--json|--toon]                   Release soak progress and the exact actions still needed
  reportcard (alias: report-card) [--json] [--toon]                 Local Go Report Card analyzer (gofmt, govet, gocyclo, misspell)
  coverage                        [--strict] [--profile=path]       Evaluate test statement coverage against package quality thresholds
  eval                            [run|ablate|init|synthesize]      Universal epistemic evaluation, multi-harness runner & ablation

Repository Setup, Rules & Onboarding:
  install [--tools=...] [--no-hooks]           Provision agent rules, git quality gates, and tool configs
  agents  [check|sync|compile|review] [--all]  Hub-and-spoke agent SOP rule compiler, drift auditor & multi-project sync
  onboard [check|--convert-tasks]              Inventory legacy task systems and verify sila participation
  heal    [--dry-run] [--json]                 Bring repository wiring, duplicate registrations & claims current
  export  [rules] [--target=...]               Dump messages/claims as JSON or compile agent rules

Sync, Ingestion & Store Operations:
  import   [--from=claude|codex|grok|all] [--project=] [--dry-run|--yes] [--json|--toon]
           Import durable memory files from Claude Code, Codex, and Grok; dry-run by default
  sync     [--project=] [--since=] [--full]  Ingest from all tools + distill claims with live progress preview
  live     [--interval=<duration>] [--compact]      Continuous live 9-box mission control cockpit & background sync
  dream    [<project>] [--llm=...]           Distill claims and atomic facts from messages (query, reconcile)
  status   [--scan]                          Sync health dashboard, tool metrics, and stale claim detection
  ingest   [<tool>|all] [--since=...]        Incremental ingestion of normalized messages from AI CLI tools
  assess   [<tool>|all]                      Dry-run preview of what ingest would pull in from local tools
  projects [merge <keep> <drop> | rename <project> <new-id>]
           Catalog indexed repositories and claim counts; merge path aliases or correct an id
  overlaps [--project=...]                   List cross-tool overlaps and co-occurrence
  store    [status|smoke|verify|migrate]     Inspect store metrics, verify invariants, and run Smoke A/B sandbox
  storage  [--json]                          Show disk footprint: sila's store plus each source tool's data
  clean    [--global|--repo] [-y]            Universal multi-toolchain disk hygiene and cache pruning
  vacuum   [--stats] [--force]               Defragment SQLite store, reclaim free pages, and optimize planner
  backup   [--out=<path>]                    Write a consistent snapshot of the knowledge store

Surfaces, Services & Integrations:
  ui                      [--port=7452] [--no-open]               Interactive local web cockpit for decisions & knowledge navigation
  demo                    [--step=<list>] [--keep] [--web]        7-stage continuity walkthrough; --web opens the Web Cockpit
  mcp                     [--profile=continuity|full] [--print-schema] [--trace-args]
                          Start Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC stdio server, print its schema, or trace argument metadata
  cloud                   [status|pull|push]                      D1 edge bridge: probe connectivity, drain cloud mailbox
  gateway                 [status|test|send]                      Pluggable external relay: Discord, Telegram, Gemini, and MCP
  sources                 [--verbose] [--json]                    Discover installed AI tools on this host: log paths & setup guidance
  connect                 [list|add|verify|demo|remove] [<harness>]
                          Connect, verify, and remove sila MCP in a second harness
  cards                   [list|show] [<card-id|session-id>] [--limit=N]
                          Inspect typed session cards written at session end
  config                  [set|get|path|explain]                  Manage settings, API keys, search engine credentials & doc sites
  changelog               [<ver>] [--timeline] [--full] [--scan]  Display Sila release history or synthesize repo release notes
  upgrade (alias: update) [--force] [--check]                     Self-upgrade sila binary to latest release
  release                 [status|preflight|check|snapshot|metadata]
                          Release status, readiness scorecard, compatibility checks, snapshots & metadata
  credits                 [<query>] [--toon|--json]               Display project credits, research inspirations, and AXI attribution
  completions             [bash|zsh|fish]                         Print a shell completion script

Common Options:
  -p, --project=<name>       Scope command to a specific project directory or ID
  -g, --global               Run operation globally across all indexed projects
      --json                 Emit machine-readable JSON output (for agents & scripting)
      --toon                 Emit compact Token-Oriented Object Notation (~40% token savings)
  -v, --verbose              Display detailed output, inspection cards, and file checks
  -n, --dry-run              Preview changes without writing files to disk
      --since=<time>         Filter by duration (e.g. 24h, 7d) or RFC3339 timestamp
      --db=<path>            Knowledge store database path (default ~/.local/share/sila/sila.db)
      --no-color             Disable colored terminal output
  -h, --help                 Show help for sila or any subcommand
  -V, --version              Print version information and exit

Examples:
  sila salam                     # Orient: working loop and repo status
  sila prime                     # Prime: concise session-start context
  sila recall "database locked"  # Recall: prior solutions before searching

Conversational phrases:
  sila say hello              -> sila salam
  sila remember error <text>  -> sila recall <text>
  sila save memo <text>       -> sila memo <text>
  Run 'sila help phrases' for all 76 phrase families, or 'sila ccli explain ...' to preview.

Learn More:
  sila help phrases        All 76 conversational CLI phrase families
  sila <command> --help    Flags and examples for one command
  sila guide               Developer Operational Guidebook (10 domains)
